// The mod's options, read once per load from its userConfig values.

import type { PluginOptions } from 'claude-code'

export type Config = {
  /** The one configured Firstmate home, absolute with no trailing slash; null when unset or relative. */
  home: string | null
  quotaCommand: string
  herdrCommand: string
  herdrMs: number
  summaryMs: number
  headroomMs: number
  headroomToastPercent: number
}

const numberOption = (value: unknown, fallback: number, min: number, max: number) =>
  typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value) ? Math.min(max, Math.max(min, value)) : fallback

const commandOption = (value: unknown, fallback: string) =>
  typeof value === 'string' && value.trim() !== '' ? value.trim() : fallback

export function configOf(options: PluginOptions): Config {
  const rawHome = typeof options.home === 'string' ? options.home.trim() : ''
  const home = rawHome.startsWith('/') ? rawHome.replace(/\/+$/, '') || '/' : null
  return {
    home,
    quotaCommand: commandOption(options.quota_command, 'quota-axi'),
    herdrCommand: commandOption(options.herdr_command, 'herdr'),
    herdrMs: numberOption(options.herdr_seconds, 5, 2, 60) * 1000,
    summaryMs: numberOption(options.summary_seconds, 30, 5, 600) * 1000,
    headroomMs: numberOption(options.headroom_seconds, 900, 60, 3600) * 1000,
    headroomToastPercent: numberOption(options.headroom_toast_percent, 10, 0, 100),
  }
}

{
  "name": "firstmate-mod",
  "version": "0.3.0",
  "description": "Quiet rail: a read-only Firstmate band above the prompt that says what needs you and what each worker is doing (live from Herdr), and a /fm-fleet pane, for one configured Firstmate home.",
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "author": {
    "name": "dctmfoo"
  },
  "repository": "https://github.com/dctmfoo/firstmate-mod",
  "homepage": "https://github.com/dctmfoo/firstmate-mod#readme",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "firstmate",
    "herdr",
    "fleet",
    "status",
    "mod"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "home": {
      "type": "directory",
      "title": "Firstmate home",
      "description": "Absolute path of the one Firstmate home this mod reads (its state/ and data/ folders). Read-only; the mod never writes there.",
      "default": ""
    },
    "herdr_command": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Herdr command",
      "description": "Executable run as `<command> agent list` to read every worker's live state.",
      "default": "herdr"
    },
    "quota_command": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Quota command",
      "description": "Executable run as `<command> --provider claude,codex --json --no-credential-refresh` for the low-headroom line.",
      "default": "quota-axi"
    },
    "herdr_seconds": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Worker read interval (seconds)",
      "description": "How often Herdr is read and joined with each worker's newest status line.",
      "default": 5,
      "min": 2,
      "max": 60
    },
    "summary_seconds": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Summary read interval (seconds)",
      "description": "How often the published home summary (calls, merges, landings) is re-read from disk.",
      "default": 30,
      "min": 5,
      "max": 600
    },
    "headroom_seconds": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Headroom read interval (seconds)",
      "description": "How often quota is re-read, for the low-headroom line and toast only.",
      "default": 900,
      "min": 60,
      "max": 3600
    },
    "headroom_toast_percent": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Headroom toast threshold (%)",
      "description": "Toast once when a provider's tightest fresh limit falls to this percentage or below. 0 turns the toast off.",
      "default": 10,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 100
    }
  }
}
